caseNameFull: Richard Allen LUMPKIN v. UNITED STATES.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied. Justice Sotomayor, with whom Justice Ginsburg joins, dissenting from the denial of certiorari: I dissent for the reasons set out in Brown v. United States , 586 U.S. ---- (2018) (Sotomayor, J., dissenting).
